inputs.prompt: A single continuous medium close-up of Claude, the orange-haired adult anime woman from <Picture 1>, standing upright against the dark wooden ritual cross in the gothic cathedral from <Picture 2>. Character identity and costume come from Picture 1: slender adult proportions, amber eyes, long copper-orange hair, ivory lace veil, orange chrysanthemum at her left temple, cream embroidered high-neck dress with orange floral motifs, small black neck ribbon and flower brooch. Use Picture 2 only for the cathedral, wooden cross, wrist chains, cool blue stained-glass light and restrained amber rim light; REDESIGN the body posture and camera angle. Level camera, symmetrical composition without Dutch angle, framing head to waist, cross beam and both bound wrists near the upper corners. Her spine is vertical, pelvis and rib cage aligned, back gently resting against the upright post, feet supported on a ledge below frame. Shoulders lowered and anatomically natural, upper arms angled gently upward, elbows slightly bent, wrists secured to the horizontal wooden beam by dark metal cuffs and short chains. No forward lunging, no bent waist, no hunched shoulders, no overstretched arms. Claude looks slightly downward toward the off-screen child, gathers one breath, then urgently says a short warning, 'その子に触らないで！' with restrained protective anger and concern. Her jaw opens naturally for speech, eyebrows knit subtly, eyes retain softness, no snarling grin, no bared clenched teeth. Only small head movement, subtle breathing and slight veil movement. Maintain the new upright posture throughout. Beautiful cinematic Japanese gothic 2D animation with fine controlled linework, consistent facial proportions, layered cel shading and richly painted background; no glossy 3D skin. No fire or smoke around her yet. No subtitles, no text, no cuts, no extra characters, no camera shake.
